metadata.datasource: Modeled research candidate converted from output/film-profile-research/evidence/spectral_film_lut/src/spectral_film_lut/negative_film/fuji_natura_1600.py. According to the upstream author these values digitize manufacturer graphs; original factory datasheets not independently cross-checked here. No new laboratory measurements. Source linear log-sensitivity extrapolation, bounded to [-12,12]; Gaussian dye/base spectral tails; 380-780 nm, 5 nm sampling. Absolute H axis reanchored by log10(12.5/ISO); each sensitivity normalized on engine D55 Hanatos 18.4% gray; positive-film neutral speed further solved on spectral transmittance. Status A inverse or source APD/CDD-to-CID inverse; small nonnegative/monotone projections recorded. Negative shoulder extended by source's assumed logistic curve; prepared H-D supports clamped outside endpoints. Three normal-CDF sublayers fitted to curves; these are numerical components, not measured physical emulsions. Identity Hanatos adaptation; no stock-specific adaptation surface, DIR-coupler, halation or particle-area calibration. Antihalation=weak and sensitivity density-over-min=0.2 are host schema defaults, not measured stock attributes; D50 is a selected viewing condition.
